confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately well grounded; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because July demand and booking timing move them a lot. Cocktail and wine were set from the local draft-beer relationship because direct price knowledge is weaker. USD values assume roughly 150 JPY per USD. The FX figure comes from RBA exchange-rate excerpts surfaced by search, not a full table read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nara is treated as a lower-priced neighbour of Kyoto, with restaurant and cafe prices at Japan's general level and accommodation tiers benchmarked against other historic Japanese tourist destinations such as Kanazawa and Nikko. July summer demand is allowed for in the hostel and hotel figures.
